title: Morning Brief: Mr. Warsh goes to Washington
title_zh: 早间简报：沃什先生前往华盛顿
summary: United Airlines headlines today's earnings calendar, along with a big swath of corporate results across industries. We've also got a very close eye on retail sales, expected to come in strong as the consumer "does it again" despite some blustering headwinds.
summary_zh: 美国联合航空 (United Airlines) 成为今天财报日历的头条新闻，同时公布的还有各行业的大量企业业绩。我们还非常密切地关注零售销售，尽管面临一些巨大的阻力，但随着消费者“再次这样做”，零售销售预计将表现强劲。

title: Meta is leading the Magnificent 7 rebound — and running straight into a wall: Chart of the Day
title_zh: Meta 领先 7 点反弹，但直接撞墙：每日图表
summary: Meta stock just came off an 11-day winning streak. The question is whether its rise has stalled.
summary_zh: Meta 股票刚刚结束了 11 天的连涨。问题是它的上涨是否已经停止。

title: Amazon to invest up to $25 billion in Anthropic as part of deal
title_zh: 作为交易的一部分，亚马逊将向 Anthropic 投资高达 250 亿美元
summary: STORY: Amazon said Monday that it will invest up to $25 billion in Anthropic.That's as the AI startup committed to spending more than $100 billion over the next 10 years on Amazon's cloud technologies.The e-commerce titan will be investing $5 billion now, and an additiona...
summary_zh: 故事：亚马逊周一表示，将向 Anthropic 投资高达 250 亿美元。这家人工智能初创公司承诺在未来 10 年内在亚马逊的云技术上投资超过 1000 亿美元。这家电子商务巨头现在将投资 50 亿美元，并追加...

title: EssilorLuxottica faces test to grow smart glass sales without hurting margins
title_zh: EssilorLuxottica 面临在不影响利润率的情况下增加智能玻璃销量的考验
summary: Franco-Italian eyewear group EssilorLuxottica is facing growing pressure from investors to show how it can scale up its ambitions for smart glasses without sacrificing margins.
summary_zh: 法国-意大利眼镜集团 EssilorLuxottica 面临着来自投资者越来越大的压力，要求其展示如何在不牺牲利润的情况下扩大智能眼镜的雄心。

title: Apple's new CEO is a product perfectionist taking on the AI age
title_zh: 苹果新任首席执行官是一位迎接人工智能时代的产品完美主义者
summary: To understand how Apple's new CEO John Ternus will run the company, pay attention to what he refuses to sell. "We never think about shipping a technology," Ternus, 50, said in a recent interview about AI ‌with tech review site Tom's Guide.
summary_zh: 要了解苹果新任首席执行官约翰·特努斯将如何管理公司，请注意他拒绝出售的东西。 “我们从来没有考虑过发布一项技术，”50 岁的 Ternus 在最近接受技术评论网站 Tom's Guide 采访时表示。

title: Apple CEO Tim Cook steps down: 7 big challenges for new CEO John Ternus
title_zh: 苹果CEO蒂姆·库克卸任：新任CEO约翰·特努斯面临7大挑战
summary: Apple's incoming new CEO John Ternus has a long list of to-dos early on.
summary_zh: 苹果即将上任的新任首席执行官约翰·特纳斯 (John Ternus) 很早就制定了一份长长的待办事项清单。

title: Tim Cook is stepping down as Apple's CEO. Investors are $4 trillion richer because of him.
title_zh: 蒂姆·库克将辞去苹果公司首席执行官一职。投资者因他而增加了 4 万亿美元。
summary: Tim Cook turned Apple into a $4 trillion behemoth during its 15 years as CEO.
summary_zh: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 在担任 CEO 的 15 年里将苹果公司打造成了价值 4 万亿美元的庞然大物。

title: Apple CEO Tim Cook to step down, John Ternus named successor
title_zh: 苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 辞职，约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 任命继任者
summary: Ross Gerber, Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management comments on Tim Cook stepping down as Apple CEO on September 1, 2026, to become Executive Chairman, passing the torch to Hardware VP John Ternus to lead the company's next era of AI and innovation.
summary_zh: 罗斯·格伯 (Ross Gerber)、格伯川崎财富与投资管理公司 (Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management) 评论蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 将于 2026 年 9 月 1 日辞去苹果首席执行官职务，出任执行董事...

title: 2 charts show why Magnificent 7 stocks are being loved again
title_zh: 两张图表显示为何 Magnificent 7 股票再次受到喜爱
summary: The earnings growth potential of the Mag 7 continues to stand out.
summary_zh: Mag 7的盈利增长潜力继续凸显。
